title: Cok dilli onboarding ve profil dili
purpose: Implements FR-E1-01: Language selection on first launch (TR/EN/ES). User picks a UI language that persists across sessions, falls back to TR, and is changeable in settings.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.note: Pre-selects current language if returning user; null on first launch

loading.description: Three skeleton radio-button rows and a disabled Continue button are shown while available languages load.

ready.description: Radio group lists TR/EN/ES with current selection highlighted. Continue button is enabled once a language is selected.

empty.description: Fallback message explains language options could not be fetched, with a Retry button to reload.

error.description: Alert banner states the language list failed to load, shows reason, and offers a Retry action.

offline.description: Cached language preference is pre-selected and editable. Continue queues the update for sync on reconnect. Offline banner is visible.
